name: Shapeshifter — the last chosen number, typed in, is its power and 7 minus it its toughness
notes: 'Shapeshifter's power is equal to the last chosen number and its toughness is equal to 7 minus that number.' gave no effect. It is a characteristic-defining ability (printed */7-*, layer 7a). The site cannot know the number chosen as it entered or in an upkeep, so it is typed into the card's value box (setCDAValue; untyped is 0, a legal choice, so 0/7). 3 typed: 3/4, 4/5 under Glorious Anthem's 7c +1/+1. Grizzly Bears is 3/3 with the Anthem and nothing else.
